decision: Three contemporaneously controlled allocations show a net whole-FFN gain after all quantization, coefficient and transfer costs. Same production images pass the original standard tolerance, extra6 and the constructed full-FFN regression. The actual down helper passes nine targeted BF16 reference cases. Adopt frozen weighted-v3; stop parameter tuning.

unchanged_contract.reference: Unmodified official Torch FFN reference for standard and constructed whole-kernel comparisons

constructed_public_whole_ffn.input_scope: Constructed within public generator component ranges, not an observed PRNG seed

remaining_representation_limit.cpu_model: RNE normalized finite BF16-derived F32 values; see numerical-bound.json for enumeration/domain
remaining_representation_limit.scope: Not a projected or normalized FFN output-error bound; not a native arithmetic/underflow proof or guarantee for arbitrary input.

numerical_evidence_scope.acceptance_boundary: Unchanged public whole-FFN acceptance after down global scale, residual, RMS and layer scale; exact raw-down checks are additional selected mapping/precision diagnostics.

preserved_component_evidence: Historical E128 up/gate and QKV/O evidence applies to unchanged components only. Weighted down uses E134-specific validation.
remaining_limit: Weighted E5 representation is approximate. Finite tests and normalized CPU error bound do not prove correctness for every input or end-to-end model inference.
